Definition: from G2596 (intensive) and G331; an imprecation:--curse.
BiblicalUsage: There shall be no more curse, but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it, and His servants shall serve Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the last page of the Bible undoes the first curse, and that is the end God had in mind all along.
